description: This file defines functions for calculating Intersection over Union (IoU) and a custom loss function for training object detection models, specifically based on YOLOv3 architecture. It includes methods for building training targets, computing various IoU metrics, and aggregating loss components for classification, bounding box regression, and objectness score.

methods.name: bbox_iou
methods.description: Calculates the Intersection over Union (IoU) or variants like GIoU, DIoU, CIoU between two bounding boxes, supporting different box formats.

methods.name: compute_loss
methods.description: Computes the combined loss for object detection, including bounding box regression loss, objectness loss, and classification loss, based on predictions and targets.

methods.name: build_targets
methods.description: Generates training targets for YOLO layers based on input targets, anchors, and model predictions, including target bounding boxes, class labels, and indices.
